name: GDC-ORD-48
description: GDC-ORD v1.1.2 is the data and reproducibility package accompanying the manuscript “OpenRoads-Compatible Evaluation of Highway Geometric Design Consistency Using Operating-Speed Profiles and Machine Learning,” prepared for submission to the Journal of Transportation Engineering, Part A: Systems (ASCE). The package supports a digital-design workflow for evaluating highway geometric-design consistency from OpenRoads-compatible LandXML geometry. It contains 48 research-constructed rural two-lane highway alignments (GDC-ORD-48) comprising 572 geometric elements and 524 successive-element pairs, together with element-level results, operating-speed profiles, geometry-extraction verification data, analysis code, machine-learning experiments, publication figures, metadata, and a frozen computational environment. The workflow extracts successive horizontal-alignment elements and associated geometric attributes from LandXML 1.2, constructs continuous 85th-percentile operating-speed profiles using published operating-speed models, evaluates Lamm Criteria I and II, quantifies disagreement among multiple published speed-model families, and evaluates machine-learning models using local and successive-element geometric descriptors. Alignment-grouped cross-validation is used to prevent elements from the same alignment from appearing in both training and test sets.
